description:
1) E-commerce Strategy & P&L Management
* Own the full e-commerce P&L, including sales, gross margin, marketing investment, promotion cost, platform fees, and overall profitability.
* Build and execute annual, quarterly, monthly, and campaign-level business plans for Shopee and TikTok Shop.
* Continuously monitor and improve Media ROI, promotion effectiveness, and overall investment efficiency.
2) Commercial Planning & Marketplace Growth
* Lead commercial planning for key platform moments, including Double Day, Mega Campaign, Brand Day, Payday, and livestream campaigns.
* Plan and optimize pricing, vouchers, bundles, GWPs, hero SKUs, NPDs, and platform-exclusive offers.
* Negotiate with platform KAMs to secure visibility, traffic support, campaign slots, and growth opportunities.
3) Social Commerce Acceleration
* Lead social commerce growth strategy across content commerce, affiliate, short-form video, livestream, creator collaboration, and conversion optimization.
* Build social commerce plans that connect awareness, product education, traffic, and sales conversion, while protecting the brand’s premium storytelling.
* Manage and optimize affiliate, creator, and livestream performance, including product selection, pricing mechanics, content direction, host performance, and scalable conversion triggers.
4) Performance Marketing & Investment Optimization
* Own and optimize e-commerce marketing investment across platform ads, affiliate, livestream, short-form video, vouchers, and campaign funding.
* Build and optimize media plans to balance brand visibility, traffic generation, sales conversion, and profitability, while continuously improving overall marketing investment efficiency.
5) In-house Marketplace Operation & Execution Excellence
* Operate Shopee and TikTok Shop end-to-end in-house, covering store operation, listing management, campaign setup, pricing/promotion updates, content updates, marketing execution, and daily store health management.
* Manage operational performance across fulfillment, stock allocation, customer service, ratings/reviews, returns/cancellations, and platform compliance.
* Coordinate with SCM, 3rd party warehouse, to ensure campaign readiness, smooth order flow, and fast issue resolution.
6) Data Analytics, Business Intelligence & Market Intelligence
* Own the e-commerce data analytics and reporting framework via Power BI to support business tracking, performance review, and decision-making.
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards that provide a clear view of business performance.
* Analyze business performance to identify growth opportunities, performance gaps, risk areas, and commercial improvement levers.
requirements_text:
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or related fields, with 5+ years of experience in e-commerce, marketplace, digital commerce, or commercial roles.
* Proven hands-on experience managing Shopee and/or TikTok Shop, preferably in premium consumer goods, home & living, retail, lifestyle, or FMCG categories.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce P&L, sales target management, margin, promotion cost, marketing investment, platform fees, and profitability levers.
* Able to operate marketplace stores end-to-end in-house, including store management, listing setup, campaign execution, pricing/promotion updates, stock coordination, and platform compliance.
* Solid understanding of social commerce, affiliate, livestream, short-form video, platform ads, media planning, and content-driven sales growth.
* Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in Excel and Power BI to translate business data into clear insights and action plans.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and coordination skills with platform KAMs, SCM, 3rd party warehouse, agencies, creators, affiliates, and internal teams.
* Hands-on, self-driven, agile, detail-oriented, and able to manage both strategy and execution in a lean, fast-paced in-house environment.
